viewer: Hindi-speaking 16-30 year olds, many from highway towns and trucking families
hook: Headlights hit a woman in white with a raised hand: Raat ko highway pe koi haath dikhaye, to gaadi mat rokna.
payoff: Pappu never stops, she keeps reappearing every 10 km, then she is in the side mirror on the back seat.
cta: A: gaadi roko, B: mirror mat dekho. Follow for more truck stories.
sources: Original story inspired by the common Indian highway-ghost folk motif (woman in white asking for a lift). Code-drawn visuals, Kalpa Labs TTS (Aman), studio-synthesized SFX/BGM. No third-party footage or audio.
